public_source.name: TraceLab
public_source.attribution: TraceLab, SyFI Lab, University of Washington
public_source.timing_semantics: Tool/runner-reported duration of a synchronous shell_command invocation; not a human response gap or an asynchronous poll-chain lifetime.

rationale: Declared shell-duration sensitivity workload. Preserve every source request, token, dependency and non-execute timer. Sample the complete nonnegative reported synchronous-shell population without a long-only threshold, scaling or tail clipping. Missing internal times are reported and never imputed.
baseline_requirements: Every compared arm uses the identical prepared timing-map file and source token corpus.
Natural native timings are source evidence, not a performance control for synthesized timing.
Inspect actual admission, safe cold capacity and migration rather than assuming longer tools force migration.
Keep the public default ThunderAgent arm and separately qualify its optional acting-token-decay arm before claiming superiority over its long-tool policy.
